short.en: National Security Council member Oliver North and his secretary start to shred documents allegedly implicating them in the Iran–Contra affair.
short.zh: 国家安全委员会成员奥利弗·诺思（Oliver North）及其秘书开始销毁据称涉及他们伊朗-孔特拉事件的文件。

short.en: No matter what people tell you, words and ideas can change the world.
God doesn't require us to succeed, he only requires that you try.
The United Auto Workers strike 92 General Motors plants in 50 cities to back up worker demands for a 30-percent raise.
World War II: HMS Rawalpindi is sunk by the German battleships Scharnhorst and Gneisenau.
short.zh: 第二次世界大战：英国皇家海军“拉瓦尔品第”号巡洋舰被德国战列舰“沙恩霍斯特”号和“格奈森瑙”号击沉。

short.en: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.
short.zh: 这一决定是在发生一系列交通事故后，加州禁止 Waymo 的无人驾驶汽车在该州高速公路上运营的。

short.en: I owe you one for what you did today.
short.zh: 你今天帮了我，我欠你个人情。
short.note: owe /oʊ/ 双元音；owe you one 连读。

short.en: Libius Severus is declared emperor of the Western Roman Empire. The real power is in the hands of the magister militum Ricimer.
You cannot find peace by avoiding life.
I usually take the bus to work in the morning.
short.zh: 我早上通常坐公交上班。
short.note: usually 重音在前；take the bus 固定搭配。

short.en: Applause waits on success.
The Holy Trinity Cathedral of Tbilisi, the largest religious building in Georgia, is consecrated.
short.zh: 格鲁吉亚最大的宗教建筑第比利斯圣三一主教座堂举行祝圣仪式。

short.en: The Princess Elizabeth (the future Queen) marries Lieutenant Philip Mountbatten, who becomes the Duke of Edinburgh, at Westminster Abbey in London.
Trust me, this is going to work out.
short.note: work out 表示“成功、解决”；going to 口语常缩为 gonna。

short.en: You must be willing to do what others won't do, to have what others won't have.
Could you pass me the salt, please?
short.note: pass me 连读；salt 长元音 /ɔːl/。

short.en: Constantine X Doukas becomes Byzantine emperor, with his son Michael as nominal co-emperor and Michael Psellos as chief minister.
It's better to be a lion for a day than a sheep all your life.
My shoes are a little tight; they hurt my feet after walking all day.
short.zh: 我的鞋有点紧，走一天后脚很疼。
short.note: tight 紧的；hurt 使疼痛，过去式同形。

short.en: Trade, connectivity and regional cooperation will be on top of the agenda when Nepal's PM meets his India counterpart.
short.zh: 尼泊尔总理与印度总理会晤时，贸易、互联互通和区域合作将成为议程的重中之重。

long.en: Founders of Italian fashion brand Dolce & Gabbana issue an apology following a series of offensive advertisements on social media promoting a fashion show in Shanghai, China, which was canceled.
long.zh: 意大利时尚品牌杜嘉班纳（Dolce & Gabbana）的创始人就一系列在社交媒体上发布的冒犯性广告道歉，这些广告旨在宣传在中国上海举办的一场时装秀，但该时装秀已被取消。

long.en: Changing a habit is rarely easy, and most people fail several times before a new routine sticks. The key is to start with one small step, forgive yourself when you slip, and keep going rather than giving up after a single mistake.
long.zh: 改变习惯很少容易，大多数人在新习惯固定下来之前会失败好几次。关键是从小步开始，失手时原谅自己，继续坚持，而不是一次出错就放弃。
long.note: routine 重音在第二音节；sticks 此处指“固定下来”；slip 小过失。

long.en: 16-year-old Gratian is proclaimed augustus following the death of his father Valentinian I, though a couple of days later his half-brother Valentinian is also proclaimed augustus and becomes his co-ruler.

words.z: a. 苦的, 痛苦的, 怀恨的
n. 外科医生, 军医, 船医
a. 艺术的, 艺术家的, 富有艺术性的
n. 读写能力, 识字, 精通文学
n. 国库, 宝库, 财政部, 国库券
a. 天资高的, 有才能的
n. 王冠, 王权, 顶点
